title: Full Stack Developer
description:
📍 Location: EU-based
💼 Cooperation type: Full-time
🧭 Work format: Remote

We’re looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our product team. You’ll work on developing and maintaining integrations for popular CMS and CRM systems, playing a key role in building scalable and high-performing technical solutions.

About us:
Stape is a global product-driven IT company and the #1 leader in the server-side tracking market. We’re building a powerful, technically complex product that simplifies server-side tracking for marketers and website owners. Our platform processes over 5 billion requests daily, helping improve tracking accuracy and data privacy for more than 200, 000 clients worldwide. We work closely with top tech partners, including Meta, LinkedIn, Google, Snapchat, and TikTok to provide advanced tracking capabilities.

We actively participate in industry-specific conferences as sponsors of events like MeasureCamp and Superweek.

Key tasks:

  • Develop and maintain apps (plugins/extensions/modules) for popular CMS systems like Shopify, WordPress (WooCommerce), Magento and others.
  • Develop and maintain apps (plugins/extensions/modules) for popular CRM system like HubSpot, Zoho, GHL, Pipedrive, Salesforce and others.
  • Manage and maintain software components to ensure they meet business needs and performance targets.

 

Your background:

  • 4+ years of active experience with Node.js and PHP.
  • Proficiency in modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Experience with API-based systems (REST, RPC).
  • Experience with Redis/Memcache or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Docker configuration.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
  • Verbal and written English and Ukrainian (for candidates from UA).
  • Practical experience with development for Shopify/Wordpress/Magento and other popular CMS systems as a plus.

 

We offer:

  • Industry Leader: Make a meaningful contribution to a globally recognized solution that shapes the future of the server-side tracking market.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy a flexible work schedule with the freedom to choose where you work.
  • Extended remote workspace setup: Experience the benefits of a fully equipped remote workspace, designed to elevate your productivity and create a comfortable work atmosphere.
  • Collaborative culture: Engage in a friendly and open team environment that encourages initiative, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Educational support: Invest in your self-development through a dedicated training and professional growth budget.
  • Well-Being: Take advantage of 30 days of paid time off (20 standard days + 10 more to cover public holidays), Parental Leave, Anniversary days off, and Study Leave to support your recharge and maintain a balance between work and personal life.
  • Health support: Feel secure with full coverage for Sick Leave and a dedicated medical insurance budget that prioritizes your health.

 

Excited to join us? Submit your CV and let’s get started!
